reviewMethod: Independent visual reading of all 28 paper pages and all 28 scheme pages; each detailed allocation checked against the scheme summary on page 7.
sourceNotes: 2021 candidate total is 230 marks: six Section A questions at 30 and one Section B question at 50. All offered questions total 390 marks.
48 separately marked units. All shared scales retain every printed component, including Q9(d)/(e), Q11(a)(ii)/(iii) and Q11(b)(i)/(ii).
Q2(a) physical triangle construction includes the scale-aware ruler. Q6(b) uses the explicitly labelled 0·5 cm grid; coordinates do not replace the printed grid scale.
Original graphs, stem-and-leaf diagrams, construction workspaces and full scheme solutions are available through the page reader.

cards.stem: Frankie wanted to buy a particular bicycle. He checked its price in 2 bicycle shops. Firstly, in Buy-Cycles, the price of the bicycle before VAT was included was €215. The VAT rate was 20%. Next, in Bikes-4-All, the normal price including VAT was €330, but there was a sale with a 25% reduction on the normal price.
cards.questionText: Find the price Frankie would have to pay for the bicycle in each shop.

cards.stem: Frankie’s aunt Breda lives in New York. Breda has to fly to Moscow on a business trip. Before her flight, she changes 1200 US dollars to Russian roubles. The exchange rate is 1 US dollar = 70·59 roubles.
